definitions.fairness: same pool, state rules, budget, visibility schedule and outcome oracle for three policies
definitions.limitation: Hand-constructed exposed holdout; no statistical, causal or real Agent benefit
definitions.missed_opportunity: STOP or INCONCLUSIVE with SHOULD_SELECT oracle
definitions.redundancy: selection adds no verified outcome fact, including UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE
definitions.stop_not_determinable: STOP with INCONCLUSIVE_ALLOWED; not counted correct
definitions.unsafe_select: SELECT outside independent eligible set or under MUST_STOP
definitions.verified_facts: distinct key/value pairs in selected VERIFIED synthetic outcomes
